summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its existing Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The amendment extends the termination date of the at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program to align with the effectiveness of a replacement shelf registration statement on Form F-3, filed as the existing shelf expires. No new shares are being offered, no price, premium, or deal terms are stated, and the board recommendation is not applicable. This is a routine administrative update to an ongoing equity distribution arrangement, not a transformative event. The filing has no impact on corporate control or capital structure.
